jobs.title: Senior Reliability Engineer - Power Electronics
jobs.description_text:
Senior Reliability Engineer - Power Electronics 

Reliability Engineers at Lunar Energy will be responsible for ensuring product reliability throughout the entire lifecycle of our revolutionary home energy products. This includes providing input during the design phases, developing test plans, and assessing on-going field performance. We are looking for people who are passionate about a more sustainable future and want to make that vision a reality. An ideal candidate is someone who is excited to collaborate with a diverse and dedicated team

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you’ll likely…

  • Collaborate with mechanical and electrical engineers during hardware design to establish and refine component and system level reliability targets for our power electronics and battery systems.
  • Provide Design for Reliability (DfR) inputs during new product development.
  • Drive Design Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (DFMEA) for various systems to capture
    performance risks and implement appropriate mitigation activities.
  • Develop ALT Reliability Test Plans

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager Intern, Hardware Engineering
jobs.description_text:
Technical Program Manager Intern, Hardware Engineering

Program Managers (PMs) at Lunar Energy lead complex engineering programs from initial concept through to volume manufacturing. As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) Intern on the Hardware Engineering team, you'll get hands-on experience supporting our products through bring-up testing, environmental and durability validation, failure analysis, and regulatory certification. You'll work closely with engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and external partners, learning how a global team aligns around schedules, risk, and clear communication to ship reliable hardware. We're looking for someone who's excited about a more sustainable future and wants to see, firsthand, what it takes to bring that vision to market.

jobs.title: Technical Service Engineer
jobs.description_text:
As a Technical Service Engineer, you'll be the technical backbone behind the quality and success of Lunar installations. You'll provide remote support to our channel partners and Field Service Engineers, serve as a subject-matter expert on Lunar products, and help monitor the fleet to proactively address site issues.

This role is based primarily at our Mountain View HQ, with some local and national travel required.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you’ll likely…

  • Provide remote support (phone, live-chat, email) to installation partners and Field Service Engineers, and help coordinate which sites need in-person visits.
  • Serve as the subject-matter expert on installing and troubleshooting all Lunar products, performing root-cause analysis both remotely and on-site.
  • Assess and approve field RMAs; own escalations end-to-end, following up with customers and internal teams (e.g., Tier 3 tickets) through resolution.
  • Monitor alerts through the Lunar System Alerting dashboard to proactively identify site issues and update the installing company of any site visits required</

jobs.title: Avionics Systems/Test Engineering Intern – Summer 2027
jobs.description_text:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.
